anya: Quick a11y pass on dataset table headers — notable issues: headers implemented as
, no aria-sort updates, chevron contrast low, focus ring barely visible. rachel: which AT/browser? anya: Firefox+NVDA and Safari+VO. NVDA doesn't announce sort changes; VoiceOver misses ascending/descending. a11y-bot: Auto-check: role="button" on non-button element (FAIL). aria-sort missing. chevron contrast 3.2:1 (warning). tanner: we used divs to keep markup simple. Should we switch to native 2) update aria-sort to ascending/descending on click 3) bump chevron color to meet contrast and restore :focus-visible outline. rachel: paste small JS/CSS so I can drop in component. anya: JS: document.querySelectorAll('th[aria-sort]').forEach(th=>{const btn=th.querySelector('button');btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const cur=th.getAttribute('aria-sort');const next=cur==='ascending'?'descending':'ascending';document.querySelectorAll('th[aria-sort]').forEach(h=>h.setAttribute('aria-sort','none'));th.setAttribute('aria-sort',next);btn.querySelector('.sr-only').textContent=`Sorted: ${next}`;document.getElementById('table-live').textContent=`Table sorted by ${btn.dataset.col}, ${next}`;});}); CSS: .th-sort{background:none;border:none;color:#0f172a;font:inherit}.th-sort:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #2563eb;outline-offset:2px}.chev{color:#0f172a} .sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0} a11y-bot: Queued checks: role semantics, aria-sort behavior, focus-visible present, live region updates. tanner: I'll implement and add axe/unit tests for aria-sort and tabbable order. joel: remember to avoid updating DOM text unnecessarily to prevent duplicate SR announcements. Update the live region only. mike: thanks — assign @tanner to PR and @rachel to review. anya: will open PR with snippets and axe results. :shipit:
